history.sg_progress: The review of open commitments is conducted throughout the year, especially at year-end, prior to the closure of the related budget period so as to ensure proper validity. That review has already been strengthened owing to the ongoing financial liquidity crisis, which forces the alignment of expenditure with contribution inflows, which tend to be heavy towards the end of the year. Over the course of 2020, the Administration has already added more intra-year reviews as a result of the liquidity crisis (see also comments in paras. 296, 298, 339, 340, 378 and 470 below).
